messages:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty - P1 triggered for RiverMark (dedicated pool rivermark-prod) — sustained 5xx spike observed on canary. Pager: oncall-sre-night
apm-bot: Spike detected: 5xx rate = 14% over last 2m; p50 latency stable. Top trace snippet: `kv_cache_miss -> kernel_alloc_fail -> oom` (see trace link)
raj-sre: I'm on it. grabbing logs and host lists now.
maria-engr: note — the canary used the q4-quantized runtime (artifact: rm-infer:v2026-03-q4q). we saw some outlier mem behavior in long seq tests but not at this rate.
raj-sre: can we isolate RiverMark tenant from the rolling canary traffic? want to stop new canary sessions hitting their dedicated pool.
eve-ops: we can divert their traffic back to a known-good artifact in the pool rather than full pool drain. recommend rm-infer:v2.1.2 (pre-quant).
sam-soleng: +1. need CSM to notify customer before action. @csm-alyssa can you loop them?
csm-alyssa: pinged the RiverMark support thread and their oncall. they want mitigation asap; are fine with temporary diversion.
raj-sre: executing divert: `rctl route set --customer rivermark --to rm-infer:v2.1.2 --mode immediate --reason "canary 5xx spike"`
deploy-bot: routing job started: `route-1767801234` — diverting canary traffic for rivermark to rm-infer:v2.1.2
maria-engr: seeing kernel logs with repeated `cu_mem_alloc` failures ~ 120s before OOMs on a subset of hosts. likely quantized GEMM path regression for long sequences.
apm-bot: Routing change applied. Observability: 5xx rate for rivermark down to 1.3% within 30s; error budget impact reduced.
raj-sre: verifying downstream effects. @csm-alyssa any reports of degraded customer experience?
csm-alyssa: RiverMark reports the UX is back to normal. they saw two failed chats during spike window earlier but nothing ongoing.
eve-ops: propose we pin the pool for rivermark to rm-infer:v2.1.2 until eng ships a safe quant patch. avoids churn and further customer impact.
maria-engr: agreed. will prepare artifact freeze for that tenant. command: `artctl freeze --pool rivermark-prod --artifact rm-infer:v2.1.2 --reason "emergency pin after canary instability"`
raj-sre: performing pool pin: `infractl pool pin --pool rivermark-prod --artifact rm-infer:v2.1.2 --by raj-sre`
deploy-bot: Pool pin job created: job-78321. job status: queued -> running -> success (applied to 8/8 hosts)
incidents-bot: Note: on-call handoff scheduled in ~20m. current owner: @raj-sre, next: @maria-engr (secondary).
apm-bot: Post-pin metrics: 5xx stable at 0.9% for rivermark. Latency within baseline.
sam-soleng: initiating canary hold for rivermark to prevent further rollouts: `canaryctl hold --customer rivermark --until 2026-03-16T04:00Z --reason "safety hold after instability"`
maria-engr: I'll open a root-cause thread in #eng-ml with kernel logs, reproducer snippets, and a small reproducer harness. tagging @ml-runtime-team.
raj-sre: filed incident ticket INC-2026-00412 with timeline, mitigation steps, and customer communications. will attach logs + deploy job IDs.
raj-sre: leaving question for ops/eng: any objections to keeping pin until we have a validated patch? this is a dedicated, revenue-impacting customer.
eve-ops: no objections. recommend suppressing noisy alerts for pinned pool to avoid paging while eng investigates.
apm-bot: Alert suppression applied: suppress 5xx alert for rivermark canary (30m window) to reduce noisiness while mitigation stabilizes.
raj-sre: preparing handoff notes for next shift in ~10m: `diverted -> rm-infer:v2.1.2`, `pool pin applied`, `canary rollouts held`, `customer notified`, `root-cause thread started`.
maria-engr: taking over. will coordinate fix validation and ETA with runtime eng. please post any new host-level logs/trace ids in this thread. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigation in place. No active customer outage at this time. Next update scheduled in 30m or on new signals.
